newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air Lines sets winter fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air Lines sets winter fare sale.

text.p: ATLANTA, Dec 30 (Reuter) Delta Air Lines said Monday it set a winter fare sale featuring discounts of up to 40 percent on flights throughout North America, Europe, Asia and the Caribbean.
The sale includes mileage-based fares ranging from $158 to $358 round-trip for travel in the U.S. and Canada, excluding Florida and Hawaii, Delta said.
The fares are good from January 6 through March 15, Delta added. The offer is good through February 12 to Florida, Hawaii, Bermuda and the Caribbean.
Passengers must buy tickets by January 13.
Passengers must buy tickets at least seven days in advance and spend a Saturday night at their destination.
Sample fares include $358 round-trip bewteen Los Angeles and Boston, compared with $548 regularly, and $198 between Cincinnati and Washington, compared with $250 regularly.
On travel to Europe, Asia, Russia and Mexico, the special fares run from January 13 to March 15. Passengers must stay a Saturday night and must buy tickets by January 8.
Sample fares include $480 round trip from Salt Lake City to Paris, compared with $797 regularly, and $372 round-trip from New York to Prague, compared with $618 regularly.
AMR Corp's American Airlines will match the Delta fares in all competitive markets, and all sale conditions will be the same, a American Airlines spokesman said.
UAL Corp said its United Airlines would also match the Delta fares on routes in which the two carriers compete.
Southwest Airlines Co said Friday it would offer lower fares through January 23 for travel from January 1 through June 2 on its U.S. flights.
Sabena Airlines said Monday it would offer a winter sale on air fares to nearly 50 destinations in Europe on flights between January 13 to March 15.
Prices start at $348 round trip from New York or Boston to Brussels on Monday through Thursday flights, Sabena said. Weekend flights cost $40 more, it added.
Passengers must buy their tickets between December 30 and January 8, Sabena said.
Delta is Sabena's partner in the U.S.
USAir Group said later it would also match Delta on all fares in markets where the two airlines compete.
